sources.researchNote: The upload identifies a modern compilation and credits production to DMI. Its album artwork and description supply no original disc label, catalogue number, matrix or session. The structured date is publication of this YouTube copy, not an independently verified album-release date or historical session. SRC0300 independently documents Garat’s Salabert 3382, but the compilation track has not been matched to that particular issue by label or matrix evidence.
